title.narrative: MFC 2021-2025 Innovation Project through Digitalization, Promotion of Green Jobs
MFC 2021-2025 Innovation Project through Digitalization, Promotion of Green Jobs

description.narrative:
MFC (Mali-Folkecenter Nyetaa) has applied to Sida for funding of 75 million SEK to carry out the "Innov-Rec" Project (Innovation Project through Digitalization, Promotion of Green Jobs) in Mali during the period 2021-2024.
The so-called Innov.Rec program is designed to support the development and scale of locally relevant climate technologies in Mali. It aims to foster processes by which new ideas are developed to meet societal, environmental and economic needs in the time of climate change. Harnessing opportunities offered by the traditional sectors of agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fisheries, health and sanitation, energy and transport, manufacturing, and services market, to name a few, local entrepreneurs are expected to creating new goods and services that embody climate technology. The program will bring incubation, capacity building and financing options to local entrepreneurs who develop innovations to meet the challenges of climate change. Through 5 Local Resources Poles (LRPs), deconcentrated structures of MFC, that will be set-up in-country and the capital city’s Technopole (based in Bamako) holistic support will be provided as well as the development, deployment, and transfer of locally relevant climate technologies. The program will also help local entrepreneurs to connect with sources of finance, providing them with the means to innovate. To do this, the program will rely on a multi-actor process involving both public actors, local entrepreneurs and civil society organizations.
The Innov-Rec program seeks to contribute to environmental and economic resilience with links to peace and social cohesion. The program will be implemented according to the 3 axes as follows:
Axis 1: employability and vocational training in the face of the challenges of climate change (green jobs, renewable energies and the productive use of these energies in jobs with high potential).
Axis 2: Digitalization, inclusive finance and innovation for local economic growth, Local Resource Poles for the benefit of entrepreneurs, NGOs, associations, GIE and microfinance cooperatives).
Axis 3: Consultation and inclusive dialog framework for climate resilience, and for peace, security and social cohesion at local and regional level.
The intervention’s total budget financed solely by Sida is 76,5 M SEK, out of which 75 MSEK will be borne by MFC and the remaining 1,5 MSEK will be managed by the Embassy for final evaluation purpose.

The contribution aims at strengthening the climate resilience and social cohesion of communities. It includes Two Specific Objectives- SO- (outcomes) mentioned below: SO1: The resilience capacities of local partners and their communities are further strengthened through the creation of decent work and environmental protection against the effects of climate change. SO 2: The inclusive dialog framework is strengthened around resilience, climate justice and social cohesion at local, regional and national level.

title.narrative: Amendment to the agreement following decision to phase out development cooperation in Mali

description.narrative:
Examples of results from Annual Review Meeting held August 30th, 2024:
R1 : The 05 Local Resource Poles and the Technopôle of Bamako have been created to facilitate and support the identification, development and implementation of green employment initiatives.
Outcome 1: •A map of regions and players, as well as data on existing initiatives, are available. •An environmental and social impact study and a gender analysis •A gender analysis has been followed by a gender action plan •Five local resource centers have been set up and are operational in the region, and a technopole in Bamako •158 green initiatives supported, including 40% for women in the 5 PRL and TP •150 market gardening cooperatives equipped with solar pumping kits (installation in progress) •7 innovative prize and 3 green action to support pilote initiatives
Initiative examples: •150 women's cooperatives equipped with solar pumps • •The Niamakoro-Bamako urban greenhouse • •E- mobility with 10 women entrepreneursh program
R2 / Outcome 2: •Digital tools are functional to facilitate cluster management work (Microsoft 360) •Project staff (PRL and TP) have the skills to use digital tools effectively •Carrying out a study on the inclusion of climate change aspects in financing
Initiative examples: •Approximately 1170 registered participants •32 exhibitors • 16 themed conferences • A list of 7 award-winning innovative and ecological projects, 40% of them women, is available
R3 / Outcome 3: •Campaign materials (videos, podcasts, quizzes, etc.) are distributed and accessible. •A total of 26 awareness campaigns organized locally and nationally •A digital awareness and information campaign #CoolAvecLaNature at national level •Six (7) educational modules designed •432 media players (journalists)
Initiative examples: •170 teachers and 7,500 schoolchildren • •428 national participants, including 113 women (26%), and 9 conferences for FENA 20217 • •500 people reached by FENA caravans in 2023 • •59 members of RESO-Climat and other CSOs trained, including 24 women (40%)
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
